lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mg6Sn2 (reduced formula Mg3Sn) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 32 atoms per unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. CrystalNN geometry-only analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements for Mg and Sn centers, with 12 geometric neighbors per Mg and 12 per Sn. Mg environments consist of Mg and Sn neighbors, while Sn centers coordinate to Mg, with neighbor distances ranging from about 3.05 to 3.31 Å. The geometric neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 32 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis shows Mg–Mg 12-vertex polyhedra sharing corners, edges, and faces, and Mg–Sn pairs sharing corners and edges.
